gitCommit.subject: feat(chat): multi-reference image attachments for Gazai Chan (#1363)
gitCommit.body:
feat(chat): multi-reference image attachments for Gazai Chan (#1363)

* feat(chat): add multi-reference image attachments for Gazai Chan

Enable users to attach up to 4 reference images per message from canvas
objects or file uploads. Extracts chat UI into reusable components
(ChatMessageBubble, ChatFooterForm, ChatImageAttachmentArea,
ChatCanvasImagePopover) and adds image utility helpers with client-side
JPEG resize for uploads. Includes i18n support across all 4 locales.

* feat(chat): increase max image attachments per message from 4 to 16

* feat(chat): add serial number badges to reference image attachments

* feat(canvas): deselect reference image if user clicks same image second time

Implement toggle behavior for canvas image attachments in chat. Clicking a canvas image once attaches it; clicking it again deselects it. This improves the UX by allowing users to easily remove accidentally selected images without having to use the attachment area buttons.

Key changes:
- Modify handleCanvasImageSelect() to check if image is already attached
- If attached, remove it; if not, add it (toggle behavior)
- Improve popover button disable logic to allow toggling off images even at max attachment limit
- Extract attachedCanvasImageIds Set for reuse in disable logic
- Add comprehensive unit tests covering toggle scenarios

Tests verify:
- First click adds image
- Second click removes image (toggle off)
- Multiple different images can be selected
- Toggle works repeatedly (on -> off -> on)
- Content type detection for PNG/JPEG
- Max attachment limit still enforced

* feat(chat): add scroll arrows to reference image attachment strip

Add left/right chevron buttons for browsing attached reference images
when the strip overflows. Uses overflow-hidden on parent and min-w-0
on the scroll container to fix flex layout scrolling, with
ResizeObserver for responsive updates. Arrows are always clickable
when overflow is detected, using opacity for visual feedback.

* feat(canvas): make generation indicator draggable with real-time placeholder movement

The Gazai Chan spinner can now be dragged during image generation.
For placeholder-based generations, dragging the spinner moves the
placeholder image and its FloatingQuickActions toolbar in real-time
via direct Konva node manipulation and useImageDragStore updates.

* feat(canvas): prevent agent panel auto-close and add Escape key dismiss

Remove the useEffect that auto-closed the agent panel when canvas
selection changed. Add Escape key handler so users can dismiss the
panel from anywhere, including when focus is inside the chat input.

* fix(canvas): remove unused variables in frame-name-label and multi-selection-group

* fix(test): use constructable function in Image mock

Arrow functions cannot be called with `new`, causing all
resizeImageToDataUrl tests to fail with "not a constructor".

* feat(canvas): auto-sync selected canvas images to chat attachments

Replace the manual ChatCanvasImagePopover with automatic selection-based
sync. When images are selected on the canvas, they now automatically
appear as reference image attachments in the Gazai Chan chat panel via
a debounced useEffect (150ms). Uploads always take priority over canvas
images for the MAX_CHAT_ATTACHMENTS (16) limit. Removing a canvas
attachment via X also deselects it on canvas to prevent re-sync.

- Extract isValidImageSrc, imageObjectToAttachment, getContentTypeFromUrl
  helpers into lib/chat-image-utils.ts
- Add buildCanvasAttachmentsFromSelection pure function with referential
  equality optimization to prevent unnecessary re-renders
- Wire useEffect in ChatFooterForm watching selection store
- Delete ChatCanvasImagePopover and remove dead i18n keys
- Add 48 unit tests for chat-image-utils, remove 7 obsolete toggle tests

* fix(canvas): resolve blank thumbnails in chat attachments after image generation

The equality check in buildCanvasAttachmentsFromSelection only compared
attachment IDs, so when a generating image's URL changed from placeholder
to the real S3 URL, the stale attachment with the blank 1x1 PNG was
returned. Add URL comparison to the equality check and filter out
placeholder images during attachment building.

* fix(E2E): resolve canvas properties panel overlay blocking in speech object test

The ExpandableChat component (z-50, pointer-events-auto) was blocking clicks on the properties panel when open. This prevented the orientation toggle and other text property controls from being interactive.

Solution: Added ensurePropertiesPanelAccessible() method to CanvasHelper that:
- Presses Escape to close the AI chat overlay
- Uses DOM introspection (elementFromPoint) to verify properties are unobstructed
- Retries Escape up to 3 times if overlay remains visible

Changes:
- Added closeAiChat() and ensurePropertiesPanelAccessible() to canvas-helper.ts
- Updated canvas-object-speech.spec.ts to call ensurePropertiesPanelAccessible() before orientation toggle

Test now passes: ✓ 綜合測試：所有功能組合使用 (30.5s)

* feat(canvas): replace hard image cap with red excess badges and submit prevention

Remove the hard 16-image limit on chat attachments. Instead, allow up to 50
images (UI safety limit) and show red numbered badges on images exceeding the
model's capacity (16). The send button is disabled when excess images are
present, with a localized warning message.

- Rename MAX_CHAT_ATTACHMENTS to MAX_CHAT_ATTACHMENT_UI_LIMIT (50)
- Add maxModelImages prop wired from getModelCapabilities
- Port excess badge pattern from FloatingTextarea to ChatImageAttachmentArea
- Add tooManyImages i18n key in en, ja, zh-CN, zh-TW
- Add unit tests for excess badges, submit prevention, and truncation

* feat(canvas): replace hard image cap with red excess badges and submit prevention

Raise the UI attachment limit from 16 to 50 (MAX_CHAT_ATTACHMENT_UI_LIMIT) and
enforce the model's maxReferenceImages as a soft limit: excess thumbnails get a
red border and index badge, a warning banner shows how many to remove, and the
send button is disabled until the count is within bounds.

* fix(canvas): add missing hook deps, memo wrappers, and type guards

- Add handleUndo/handleRedo/handleCopy/handleCut to useCallback deps
  in useCanvasKeyEvents to fix stale closure bug
- Wrap ChatMessageBubble in React.memo to prevent unnecessary re-renders
- Add proper type guards for toolInvocation.result.message access
- Cache Konva placeholder node ref during drag instead of querying
  Stage.findOne() on every mouse-move frame
- Replace non-null assertion with explicit null check in onDragMove

* fix(canvas): harden image upload with size/pixel validation, Sentry-aware logging

Add a 10 MB file-size gate and a 64-megapixel resolution guard to
reject oversized uploads before expensive canvas work begins. Split the
drawImage/toDataURL try-catch so errors name the failing operation, and
pass Error objects to logger.error as the second parameter so Sentry
actually captures them. Log file-size rejections at warn level for
analytics visibility.

* feat(chat): forward reference images from chat attachments to generateImage tool

Wire chat image attachments through to the Gemini image generation API so
GAZAI-chan can use user-provided reference images for character consistency
and style coherence.

- Add useReferenceImages boolean to generateImage tool schema (default true)
- Resolve canvas attachments to DB image IDs via ImageObject.imageIds
- Upload data-URL attachments to S3 and return new DB IDs
- Snapshot attachments in a ref that survives multi-turn consent flow
- Update system prompt with reference image usage guidance
- Add unit tests for resolveReferenceImageIds, system prompt, and integration

* refine(canvas): remove diagnostic logs and clarify reference-image prompt

Strip all [RefImg] / [resolveRefIds] console.log statements added during
debugging, sharpen the system-prompt wording so the LLM knows exactly when
to set useReferenceImages to false, and update the test assertion to match.

* fix(canvas): correct import path for suggested-replies utility

The module moved to utils/chat/ but this consumer still referenced
the old utils/ path, causing a build-breaking 500 on every canvas page.

* fix(canvas): remove dead useEffect that referenced undefined setSuggestedReplies

The useEffect called setSuggestedReplies which was never declared,
causing a ReferenceError on every canvas page mount. The suggested
replies feature is now handled per-message inside ChatMessageBubble.

* fix(canvas): restore SuggestedToolsForMessage in refactored chat bubble

The component was accidentally dropped when chat.tsx was refactored to
extract ChatMessageBubble into a separate file, breaking AI tool
recommendation cards in GAZAI Chan.
